 Allison Thacker – Different Perspectives and Different Assets at Rice University (EP.348) Nov 6, 2023

 Allison Thacker is the President and Chief Investment Officer of
Rice Management Company, where she oversees Rice University's $8
billion dollar endowment. Allison spent eleven years picking growth
stocks before joining Rice eleven years ago.

 

Our conversation shares Allison’s keen insights from experience as
both a direct investor and endowment manager, Rice’s quite
different portfolio with a heavy allocation to real assets, and an
organizational structure that blends internal and external
management and generalists and deep specialization.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
